papers.title: Video2Skill: From Streaming Experience to Reusable Embodied Skills
papers.desc: Manipulation behaviors vary widely across objects and scenes, but they share a small set of reusable skills, and planning with these skills helps embodied agents generalize to new tasks.

papers.title: ProgressCompass: Embodied Progress Reward Models Are Lost Without the Right Context
papers.desc: Embodied agents now take on ever longer tasks.

papers.title: DeskForge: Dense Supervision from Desktop Environments for Computer-Use Agents
papers.desc: Computer-use agents need to reliably ground action targets in complex desktop scenes, where multiple applications, overlapping windows, and visually similar controls compete for attention.

papers.title: World Editing: Intervening on Executable Worlds at Increasing Depth
papers.desc: Interactive world models are increasingly capable of generating environments and acting within them, yet deliberately editing an existing executable world remains underexplored.

papers.title: COSMI: COmpositional Synthesis of Multi-object Interactions
papers.desc: Generative models of human-object interaction are bounded by the data that exists: everyday activities involve several objects, but most captured datasets record one at a time, as multi-object capture is combinatorially expensive.

papers.title: Adaptive Fused Prior Transfer for Controllable Generative Image Compression
papers.desc: Learned image compression achieves competitive rate-distortion performance, but very-low-bitrate reconstruction remains challenging because the transmitted representation cannot preserve fine textures and local structures.

papers.title: LLM-as-Jev: LLMs Are Already Jev-Style Decision Models -- When and How to Fine-Tune Them
papers.desc: Jev-style decision models return categorical probability distributions over predefined options without generating free-form text, enabling software systems to act on their outputs directly.

papers.title: Collaborative Personalized Preference Alignment for LLMs under Data Deficiency
papers.desc: Real-world users often exhibit highly heterogeneous preferences over multiple objectives for LLM responses.

papers.title: Beyond Semantic Similarity: Performance and Costs of Agentic Retrieval for Complex Tasks
papers.desc: Modern information systems, including many agentic workflows, use dense retrieval to explore large amounts of unstructured data.

papers.title: Learning Latent Protein Languages for Autoregressive Generation
papers.desc: Autoregressive transformers remain comparatively weak for protein sequence and structure generation.

papers.title: FairRSFM: A Biome-Aware Benchmark and Debiasing Framework for Remote Sensing Foundation Models
papers.desc: Remote sensing foundation models (RSFMs) are commonly evaluated using aggregate metrics, which can hide systematic performance disparities across ecological regions.

papers.title: MM-ABC: Towards Generalist Mobile Manipulation via Seeing, Coordinating and Imagining
papers.desc: Mobile manipulation extends robot interaction beyond a fixed kinematic workspace by making the reachable region itself controllable.

papers.title: Labels Override Definitions in Jev-Style Typed Decision Models
papers.desc: A typed decision model answers a fixed question about an input by returning a probability for each of several caller-defined options.

papers.title: iADD: Improving Alignment and Diversity in Diffusion Policy Optimization
papers.desc: Reinforcement learning based post training of diffusion models, such as Denoising Diffusion Policy Optimization (DDPO), optimizes a reverse diffusion process under a reward function.

papers.title: Foresight: planning future perception in streaming VLMs without retraining
papers.desc: Existing streaming vision-language models (VLMs) continuously perceive and reason over visual streams, but their computational pathways remain fixed throughout inference.
